caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cradle with an open framework structure composed of vertical spindles on all four sides, joined by horizontal rails at the top and bottom. The cradle stands on two curved rockers that extend outward at each end, allowing it to rock back and forth. The wood is shown in shades of brown, with careful attention to the grain and shadows. Inside the cradle, there is a multicolored patchwork quilt with a geometric square design; the dominant colors in the quilt include red, yellow, blue, black, and white. The background is plain and light in color, with minimal shading beneath the cradle for depth. The artist's signature, “Geoffrey Holt,” is visible at the lower right of the image.
title: Doll's Cradle
